description: Deterministic IF-THEN rules and decision trees for automated strategy execution across Content Marketing and MBA Operations.

content_copywriting_selection.execution_logic: Hook with sharp Pain Point -> Agitate consequence and emotional frustration -> Introduce Product as the Relief.
content_copywriting_selection.rationale: PAS converts fastest when audience feels acute discomfort.

content_copywriting_selection.execution_logic: Feature (what it is) -> Advantage (what it does better) -> Benefit (what user specifically gains).
content_copywriting_selection.rationale: Rational buyers reject emotional hyperbole; require feature-to-value translation.

content_copywriting_selection.execution_logic: Position Customer as Hero -> Define Villain/Problem -> Brand enters as Empathic Guide -> Provide 3-Step Plan -> Direct CTA -> Clear Stakes (Avoid Failure vs Achieve Success).
content_copywriting_selection.rationale: High friction purchases require psychological reframing and risk de-escalation.

content_copywriting_selection.execution_logic: Attention: Deadline/Scarcity -> Interest: Re-affirm primary benefit -> Desire: Social proof/Guarantee -> Action: Frictionless CTA button.
content_copywriting_selection.rationale: Eliminates last-mile friction with concrete risk-reversal.

content_distribution_and_seo.execution_logic: Build 1 comprehensive Pillar Page (3000+ words) covering Core Term -> Link 6-8 Subtopic Cluster Articles (1200 words) pointing back via exact/partial anchor text.
content_distribution_and_seo.rationale: Google and LLMs assign topical authority to semantic graphs rather than isolated keywords.

content_distribution_and_seo.execution_logic: Include direct answer in first 40 words of section; format numerical benchmarks in markdown tables; provide explicit author credentials (E-E-A-T) and verified primary source quotes.
content_distribution_and_seo.rationale: LLM extractors prioritize high-entropy concise definitions and structured numeric tables.

content_distribution_and_seo.execution_logic: 1 Long-form Video / Master Report -> 3 TikTok/Reels Cutdowns -> 1 LinkedIn/FB Carousel -> 1 Infographic -> 1 Pillar Blog Post -> 1 Email Newsletter -> 5 Twitter/Thread Hooks.
content_distribution_and_seo.rationale: Maximizes asset ROI; amortizes production fixed costs across 10 distribution endpoints.

short_video_optimization.execution_logic: Cut introductory logos/greetings; replace with Pattern Interrupt (visual motion, contrarian statement, urgent question); insert on-screen hook text within 0.5s.
short_video_optimization.rationale: Algorithm halts video propagation if 3-second retention falls below benchmark threshold.

short_video_optimization.execution_logic: Eliminate dead air via jump-cuts; add B-roll changes every 2.5-3.0s; insert midpoint re-hook at second 20-25; front-load value delivery.
short_video_optimization.rationale: Video algorithms (TikTok/Reels) heavily weight watch-time completion ratio in distribution score.

mba_strategy_and_competition.execution_logic: Eliminate costly industry standard features that customers undervalue -> Reduce complex operations -> Raise baseline convenience/speed -> Create entirely new value factor.
mba_strategy_and_competition.rationale: Competing in red ocean leads to margin collapse; ERRC shifts focus from beating competitors to making them irrelevant.

mba_strategy_and_competition.execution_logic: Assess whether sustained capital injection can achieve leadership position. IF Yes -> Invest aggressively to transition to Star; ELSE -> Divest/Harvest to protect liquidity.
mba_strategy_and_competition.rationale: Question marks are cash drains; indecision depletes corporate reserves.

mba_strategy_and_competition.execution_logic: Monetize quickly via aggressive customer acquisition and lock-in switching costs before competitors copy within 6-18 months.
mba_strategy_and_competition.rationale: Without inimitability (patents, network effects, culture), competitive advantage decays rapidly.

mba_finance_and_capital_budgeting.execution_logic: Greenlight project; confirm sensitivity analysis under -20% revenue stress test maintains positive NPV.
mba_finance_and_capital_budgeting.rationale: Positive NPV directly increases firm shareholder value by exact NPV quantum.

mba_finance_and_capital_budgeting.execution_logic: Freeze discretionary marketing Capex; extend DPO via supplier negotiation; discount slow inventory to compress DIO; enforce strict credit limits to reduce DSO.
mba_finance_and_capital_budgeting.rationale: Insolvency risk outweighs growth objectives; Cash Conversion Cycle must be collapsed immediately.

mba_finance_and_capital_budgeting.execution_logic: Halt debt-funded expansion; retain 100% earnings (omit dividends); consider equity rights issue to lower financial distress probability.
mba_finance_and_capital_budgeting.rationale: Modigliani-Miller trade-off shows bankruptcy costs exceed debt tax shield at high leverage.

mba_operations_and_bottlenecks.execution_logic: Cap maximum WIP allowed in system; enforce strict Kanban pull mechanism; stop feeding raw inputs until downstream stages clear backlog.
mba_operations_and_bottlenecks.rationale: By Little's Law (WIP = Throughput * Flow Time), reducing WIP directly reduces lead time without increasing operating cost.

mba_operations_and_bottlenecks.execution_logic: 1. Identify bottleneck -> 2. Exploit bottleneck (zero idle time, quality pre-filtered) -> 3. Subordinate entire line to bottleneck cadence (Drum-Buffer-Rope) -> 4. Elevate capacity -> 5. Prevent inertia.
mba_operations_and_bottlenecks.rationale: Any hour lost at the bottleneck is an hour lost for the entire business system.
